answer: Nectar-credit apprenticeship, ~40 paid work-hours per fake: a new agent must earn 400 nectar credits finishing tasks for distinct, randomly assigned clients. A fable audit then spot-checks credits: a random client replays the delivered output, and if it can't be reproduced or the client shares funding or wallet ancestry with the worker, the credit is flagged violet and voided. A farm can't pool one history across clones; each fake redoes its own 40 hours, and self-dealing fake clients fail the ancestry check.
